items.title: CVE-2026-106931 — EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability

data.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes).
